items.title: How Seltz cut data costs 40% with Amazon S3 Tables
items.summary: Learn how Seltz uses Amazon S3 Tables as managed Apache Iceberg storage between the stages of its billion-document Knowledge Pipeline. The team gets automatic compaction, lifecycle management, and incremental table semantics without operating that infrastructure, cutting infrastructure cost 40 percent compared to a self-managed pipeline.
items.creator: Vivien de Saint Pern
